verification.siteAccess: uiverse.io returns HTTP 403 Cloudflare to plain HTTP clients and to a normal headless browser from this environment; not bypassed (see VERIFICATION.md)
verification.pageCaptures: page-captures/ (2 Cloudflare-block proofs, 3 pinned-revision blob captures, 1 offline render proof)
verification.localRender: render-check/index.html — 5/5 frames paint offline, CSS-only, no external assets, srcdoc decodes byte-exact to each raw SHA-256

coherenceClaim: Same author, same border/shadow/colour/press grammar. NOT an official design system; NOT a uniform radius; role-specific geometry is preserved as published.
localExtensionsNotSourced: state feedback (loading / error / disabled) on the adopted grammar
